type.label: Project type
type.createTip: Motor: the motor specification and Motors & results. Controller: the controller specification, for internal controller work. Only an admin changes the type later.
type.switchTip: Switches the specification form and the results tab of this project. The data of the other form is kept.
type.confirmBody: The project shows the specification form and the results tab of this type. Nothing stored is deleted; switching back shows the earlier form again.

spec.tipEdit: The controller specification of this project. Every number has a status: requirement, model or measured, and a source (a document, a study, a bench run). Save records what changed.
spec.tipRead: The controller specification of this project. Only the project owner and admins change it.
spec.perBuildTip: One value per build of the Supply step.
spec.noBuilds: Add the builds in step 2 (Supply) first.
spec.statusTip: Requirement: what the controller must reach. Model: computed. Measured: from a test on a board.
spec.conflict: Somebody saved the controller specification in the meantime. Your values are still in the form; reload to see the saved ones (your unsaved values are then discarded).
